fields.name: master-campaign-id
fields.label: Master Campaign ID
fields.description: UUID from Campaign Manager. Required — block will not render without this.

fields.name: poll-name
fields.label: Poll Name (cookie key)
fields.description: Unique key used as the cookie name to track whether the visitor has already voted. Use kebab-case (e.g. rinvoq-as-poll-1). Required.

fields.name: question-id
fields.label: Question ID (UUID)
fields.description: UUID of the specific question within the campaign (QuestionId from Campaign Manager).

fields.name: question-text
fields.label: Question Text (optional override)
fields.description: If blank, question text is fetched from Campaign Manager via API.

fields.name: result-label
fields.label: Results Label
fields.description: Heading shown above the percentage results.

fields.name: result-description
fields.label: Results Description
fields.description: Optional rich text shown below the percentage results.

fields.name: option
fields.label: Answer Option (fallback)
fields.description: Format: 'Option Label | OptionId-UUID'. Used when Campaign Manager API is unavailable. Add one row per option. Must have at least 2 to activate fallback.

fields.name: error-timeout
fields.label: Timeout Error
fields.description: Shown when any API request times out.

fields.name: error-no-poll
fields.label: Poll Unavailable Error
fields.description: Shown when the getAssessment API fails or returns no matching question.

fields.name: error-fetch-results
fields.label: Fetch Results Error
fields.description: Shown when the getAggregated API fails.

fields.name: error-save
fields.label: Save Error
fields.description: Shown when the saveAssessment POST fails.
